definitions.explanation: The first month of the year, especially the first few days.

examples.english: Stores are closed during New Year's.
I went to a shrine for New Year's.

examples.japanese: {正月|しょうがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごします→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spend New Year's with my family.

examples.japanese: {正月|しょうがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During New Year's, relatives gather and have a meal together.

examples.japanese: {正月|しょうがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: Since work was off during New Year's, I went back to my hometown after a long time and spent it with my family.

notes:
{正月|しょうがつ} refers to the New Year period, the most important holiday season in Japan.

KEIGO:
Often prefixed with ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧ as ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{正月|しょうがつ} in polite speech.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{正月|しょうがつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome the New Year
- {正月|しょうがつ}⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧: New Year's holiday
- {正月|しょうがつ}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: New Year's cuisine (おせち)
- {正月|しょうがつ}⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧: New Year's decorations

CULTURAL NOTE:
Typically refers to January 1-3 (⟦{三が日|さんがにち}→三が日：16219_sanganichi⟧). Families gather, visit shrines (⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧), eat special foods, and give children ⟦お{年玉|としだま}→お年玉：08452_otoshidama⟧ (money gifts). Many businesses close during this period.
